articles.title: Apple will limit Mac disk access as AI agents ‘substantially’ increase risk

articles.title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
articles.essence: It's a tale as old as last week: OpenAI's new agent platform, called Dots, is full of cute little guys who can do your bidding. But unlike the ultra-approachable Meta Muse, Dots feel very much like using workplace software that happens to be able to order you a burrito - emphasis on work.

articles.title: Breaking up (with Elon Musk) is hard to do
articles.essence: In a throwback to MySpace-style internet drama, Shivon Zilis announced that she and the father of her four children, Elon Musk, had broken up on X. To do so, she quote-tweeted a post from "Big Tech Alert," an account that, among other things, monitors what accounts are following and unfollowing each other.
